sections.heading: Detection and escalation
paragraphs: The SOC triages high-confidence alerts within 20 minutes and opens a commander bridge for severity one events. The commander, forensic lead, clinical operations liaison and communications lead have named duties. Patient-safety and customer operations leads are paged after severity confirmation.
The incident commander records scope, containment, evidence hashes and hand-off to recovery. Tabletop observations feed the next monthly control review.

sections.heading: Communication
paragraphs: The internal call tree is tested quarterly. External messages use approved customer communication templates. The Pune clinical-operations paging group is not included in the current internal notification connector.
